# Dr. Pedro de Paula Junior

Official website of Dr. Pedro de Paula Junior, a physician practicing general surgery and digestive system surgery in Santa Fé do Sul, São Paulo, and performing digestive examinations in Iturama, Minas Gerais, Brazil.

Core credentials:
- CRM-SP 112723
- CRM-MG 47662
- RQE 28023 / 28024
- FAMERP graduate, 2003
- Training in General Surgery, Digestive System Surgery, Endoscopy and Colonoscopy

Main services:
- General and digestive surgery
- Laparoscopic surgery
- Abdominal wall hernia surgery
- Gallbladder surgery
- Upper digestive endoscopy
- Colonoscopy
- Hydrogen breath testing
- Evaluation of reflux, gastritis, peptic ulcers, SIBO, dysbiosis and bowel symptoms
- Treatment of hemorrhoids, anal fissures and fistulas
- Selected minor surgeries

Locations:

- Iturama, MG: Hospital Nossa Senhora Aparecida, Rua Ituiutaba, 712, Centro. Phone/WhatsApp: +55 34 3411-9900
